text:
leah: Photo drop! Riley (dog) has discovered our tiny travel umbrella and is refusing to move. Looks like a soggy loaf under a bumbershoot :umbrella: :dog: (pic attached)

sam: omg the way his ears peek out is peak dramatics :rofl: pls name the weather phenomenon he represents

marta: "puddle monarch" is my vote. also hope he's dry and warm!

josh: is that an actual doggy coat under the umbrella or is he wearing my old hoodie again?

leah: bit of both. pro tip: the hoodie is actually his favorite blanket disguise. he burrows then emerges like a grumpy submarine.

ops-bot: leah added a file: riley-umbrella-soggy-loaf.jpg (1.1MB)

dev: i demand a slo-mo of the emergent submarine manoeuver. someone get slowcam. :camera_with_flash: :sunglasses:

sam: quick poll -- caption for this photo: 1) "Umbrella? More like umbrel-lol." 2) "Puddle Monarch in his natural habitat." 3) "Do not disturb, professional loafing." React with 1/2/3 or reply with your own.

marta: reacting 3. that is pure focus face.

josh: 2 and i will sketch a tiny crown later.

leah: also note: umbrella is actually anchored with a mug so he can't steal it for walks. safety first.

dev: safety cups > anything. also can someone add a recurring "pet photo hour" event? low-commit, high-joy.

sam: absolutely yes. i'll set a poll for best weekly slot (friday afternoon looks cute).

leah: thanks all. riley will accept head pats through the fabric. he sends a single damp snooze. :zzz:
